env.description: The APNs key's .p8 contents (PEM; `\n` line breaks are accepted).

env.name: APNS_TOPIC
env.description: The iOS app's bundle id (default com.coss.ios).

env.name: APNS_ENVIRONMENTS
env.description: APNs gateways the key is configured for (production, sandbox, or both comma-separated; default both). Devices registered for another are skipped.

env.name: SENTRY_DSN
env.value: DSN of the `worker` Sentry project (Project settings → Client Keys)
env.description: Unset: nothing is reported.

env.name: SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Sentry environment; defaults to NODE_ENV.

env.name: SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
env.description: Share of requests/jobs traced (0–1).

env.name: SENTRY_RELEASE
env.value: Set by the image (build argument SENTRY_RELEASE, the commit); don't override.
env.description: Sentry release of every event.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: RDS Postgres over verified TLS (the images ship the RDS CA bundle at that path).

env.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
env.description: pg pool size per task. Sum over all tasks must stay below RDS max_connections.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.description: Signs sessions. Same value for web and api.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
env.description: Origin of both zones (site and dashboard): base URL, trusted origin, secure cookies.

env.name: EMAIL_PROVIDER
env.description: Live environments send through SES.

env.name: AWS_REGION
env.description: Printed by ses:bootstrap.

env.name: SES_CONFIGURATION_SET
env.description: Printed by ses:bootstrap.

env.name: SES_TENANT_PREFIX
env.description: Printed by ses:bootstrap.

env.name: INBOUND_MANAGED_DOMAIN
env.description: Receiving: each environment's `<label>.<domain>` addresses (ses:bootstrap --managed-domain). Set with SES_INBOUND_BUCKET, or neither (receiving off).

env.name: SES_INBOUND_BUCKET
env.description: Receiving: the bucket received emails are stored in. Printed by ses:bootstrap.

env.name: TRACKING_DOMAIN_PROVIDER
env.description: Custom tracking domains are Cloudflare for SaaS custom hostnames.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Cloudflare API token limited to the coss.com zone with SSL and Certificates: Edit (custom hostnames). Same value for web, api and worker.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID
env.description: The coss.com zone id (Cloudflare dashboard, zone overview).

env.name: TRACKING_CNAME_TARGET
env.description: The zone's fallback origin, which customers CNAME their tracking domain to.

env.name: VALKEY_URL
env.description: ElastiCache Serverless TLS URL printed by valkey:bootstrap; shared by web, api and worker.

env.name: VALKEY_CLUSTER
env.description: ElastiCache Serverless uses the cluster protocol.

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PREFIX
env.description: Counter namespace; must match the cache user's ACL.

env.name: TRACKING_PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Origin of the open/click tracking links in emails (defaults to API_PUBLIC_URL): its own domain, so abuse flagged by URL blocklists never lands on coss.com (infra/aws/routing.ts).

env.name: SMTP_HOSTNAME
env.description: The relay's name: its greeting and its certificate's name.

env.name: SMTP_TLS_CERTIFICATE_ARN
env.description: The relay exports this ACM certificate at start and every 12 hours (ACM renews it).

env.name: SMTP_TLS_PASSPHRASE
env.value: openssl rand -base64 32 (any value; it only protects the exported key in transit)
env.description: Encrypts the private key ACM exports; the relay decrypts it in memory.

env.name: SMTP_TLS_CERT_FILE
env.description: Development only (with SMTP_TLS_KEY_FILE): a certificate from files.

env.name: SMTP_TLS_KEY_FILE
env.description: Development only: the key of SMTP_TLS_CERT_FILE.

env.name: SENTRY_DSN
env.value: DSN of the `smtp` Sentry project (Project settings → Client Keys)
env.description: Unset: nothing is reported.

env.name: SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT
env.description: Sentry environment; defaults to NODE_ENV.

env.name: SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE
env.description: Share of requests/jobs traced (0–1).

env.name: SENTRY_RELEASE
env.value: Set by the image (build argument SENTRY_RELEASE, the commit); don't override.
env.description: Sentry release of every event.

oneOffTasks.name: migrate
oneOffTasks.when: Before every deploy, alone (never two at once). Needs only DATABASE_URL.

oneOffTasks.name: ses-bootstrap
oneOffTasks.when: Once per stage after the first migrate, and after upgrades that change it. Needs DATABASE_URL, AWS_REGION and a task role allowed to manage SES, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, IAM and CloudWatch.

oneOffTasks.name: create-admin
oneOffTasks.when: Once, after that user signed up: makes them a platform admin. Run with the api service's environment.

oneOffTasks.name: webhooks-reencrypt
oneOffTasks.when: When rotating WEBHOOK_SECRETS_KEY, after every service runs with the new key first: moves endpoint secrets onto it so older keys can be removed. Needs DATABASE_URL and WEBHOOK_SECRETS_KEY.

ui.host: the ui zone's production hostname (Vercel), set at provisioning

origin.host: the origin zone's production hostname (Vercel), set at provisioning

qnot.host: the qnot zone's production hostname (Vercel), set at provisioning

cachedBehaviours.reason: The dashboard's hashed, immutable assets (and old chunks for tabs opened before a deploy).
